columns.name: product_id
columns.description: Stable product ID, matching stores.json and CAD manifest

columns.name: store_id
columns.description: Stable retailer ID

columns.name: store_name
columns.description: Retailer name from the original catalog

columns.name: product_name
columns.description: Original catalog product name

columns.name: sku
columns.description: Retailer SKU, empty when not supplied

columns.name: product_url
columns.description: Original official product page

columns.name: store_category
columns.description: Original normalized technical category

columns.name: primary_role
columns.description: Main builder role; enum in taxonomy.json

columns.name: secondary_roles
columns.description: Optional alternative roles; pipe-separated, excludes primary

columns.name: part_type
columns.description: Specific component type; enum in taxonomy.json

columns.name: assembly_level
columns.description: complete_robot, module, component, kit, or accessory

columns.name: function_summary
columns.description: Researched physical function, paraphrased from the source

columns.name: classification_reason
columns.description: Reason for the inferred body role, not a vendor anatomical claim

columns.name: classification_confidence
columns.description: high, medium, or low; confidence in the suggested classification, not compatibility

columns.name: assembly_notes
columns.description: Purchased scope, exclusions, or extra parts needed

columns.name: price
columns.description: Original single-unit catalog price; not refreshed by classification research

columns.name: currency
columns.description: Original currency code; no conversion

columns.name: price_captured_at
columns.description: Date of the original price snapshot, YYYY-MM-DD

columns.name: spec_snapshot
columns.description: Technical specification summary retained from the original catalog

columns.name: evidence_status
columns.description: live_verified, catalog_snapshot_only, or inaccessible

columns.name: evidence_urls
columns.description: Pipe-separated official source URLs consulted; snapshot URLs are marked by evidence_status

columns.name: evidence_note
columns.description: Brief source finding; body-role mapping remains an inference

columns.name: researched_at
columns.description: Classification research date, YYYY-MM-DD

columns.name: image_url
columns.description: Vendor product-image URL extracted from official page metadata/main image; not locally downloaded

columns.name: image_source_url
columns.description: Product page from which the image URL was extracted

columns.name: image_captured_at
columns.description: Date of the saved page used for the image URL

columns.name: cad_status
columns.description: Original collection status; downloaded_3d, related_model_only, or not_found_in_checked_sources

columns.name: cad_formats
columns.description: Pipe-separated formats from the collection manifest

columns.name: cad_source_urls
columns.description: Pipe-separated original CAD download/source URLs

columns.name: cad_local_paths
columns.description: Pipe-separated original/extracted asset paths relative to repository root

columns.name: cad_notes
columns.description: Revision, product-family, or included-parts caveats from the CAD manifest

columns.name: browser_model_path
columns.description: Prepared GLB path relative to repository root, empty if not yet prepared

columns.name: browser_thumbnail_path
columns.description: Prepared PNG thumbnail path relative to repository root, empty if not yet prepared

columns.name: review_flags
columns.description: Pipe-separated flags for uncertain classifications, non-live evidence, or related-only CAD
